connectionTimeout.title: Connection Timeout
connectionTimeout.subtitle: We couldn't get a response from the local ArkKVM service. Please make sure it's running and reachable.
items: Confirm the ArkKVM helper/service is running on this computer
If you just started the device, wait a few seconds and try again
Restart the ArkKVM app or your computer if the problem persists

new.title: Preparing Connection
items: Initializing remote session
Setting up communication channels
Ready to connect to your device

connecting.title: Connecting...
items: Establishing secure connection with your device
Negotiating WebRTC session parameters
This may take a few seconds depending on network conditions

connected.title: Connected
items: You are now remotely connected to your device
Video and audio streams are active
If you encounter delay, check your network performance

disconnected.title: Connection Lost
items: The connection was interrupted due to network instability
Ensure your network connection is stable and active
If using Wi-Fi, try staying closer to the router or switch to wired network

failed.title: Connection Failed
items: The device may be unreachable or not responding
Ensure the device is powered on and connected to the network
Check if any firewall or router settings are blocking the connection
If using STUN/TURN, ensure the signaling server is available

closed.title: Connection Closed
items: The remote session has ended or was manually stopped
Your device may have restarted or switched networks
Click "Reconnect" to establish a new session

noSignal.title: No Signal
items: No video signal detected from the source device.
Check if the source device is powered on.
Verify that the HDMI cable is securely connected.

noLock.title: Signal Not Locked
items: The HDMI signal is detected but cannot be locked.
This may indicate unstable or incomplete video output.
Try reconnecting the HDMI cable or restarting the source device.

disconnected.title: HDMI Cable Disconnected
items: The HDMI cable has been disconnected from the device.
Please reconnect the HDMI cable securely at both ends.
Ensure the cable is not damaged and the connectors are clean.

tips.title: Tips:
items: To use this feature on a local network, please switch to HTTPS mode in the access settings.
Manually enable camera streaming in the interface before using the local camera.

tips.title: Tips:
items: To use this feature on a local network, please switch to HTTPS mode in the access settings.
Manually enable microphone streaming in the interface before using the local microphone.

header.title: Stream Metrics Center
header.desc: Real-time statistics for inbound / outbound media streams and control channels.

hero.title: Welcome to ArkKVM
hero.subtitle: Use any computer remotely
hero.line1: ArkKVM is a tiny IP KVM with PoE, two-way audio and file transfer.
hero.line2: It turns remote control into true remote computing.

authMethod.title: Local Authentication Method
authMethod.subtitle: Select how you would like to secure your local access to **ArkKVM**.
authMethod.passwordDesc: Secure your access with a password for added protection.
authMethod.noPasswordDesc: Access without password protection. It may expose your data and privacy to significant risks.
authMethod.footerNote: You can change it later in Settings.

setupBtn.note: You can change it later in Settings.

speaker.title: Sound Playback
speaker.line1: Enable **Sound Playback** to play audio from the remote computer on your host via ArkKVM.
speaker.line2: Switch this on if you need sound from the remote device.

microphone.title: Microphone Emulation
microphone.line1: Enable **Microphone Emulation** to make your host computer's microphone available to apps on the remote computer.
microphone.line2: Turn this on if your use case requires microphone input.

fileTransfer.title: File Transfer
fileTransfer.line1: Enable a **Virtual USB Drive** for two-way file transfer between your computer and the remote system.

autoUpdate.title: Automatic Updates
autoUpdate.subtitle: Automatically install **software updates** to keep your device secure and up to date.

complete.title: Welcome to ArkKVM
complete.subtitle: Experience the next-generation way of using computer remotely.
